subject: favicon
brief: 16px-first tab mark. Faithful to the dithered maze. No wordmark (or 1px implied). Do not ship until Phil picks.
axes: control PNG vs crop vs plan

takes.A: 32px PNG well + MATRIX wordmark. Pixelates at 16px; too much lettering for a tab.
takes.B: Same dithered well, cropped to the pit. No title band.
takes.C: Plan of a tiny perfect maze. Walls are one unit; no title.
takes.D: One corridor meeting a crossbar. Reads as maze, not a plus-cubie or D-pad.
takes.E: The intended ribbon on black — gold path as the mark, walls implied.
takes.F: A rectangle opening and one path into it. The run’s job, not the map.
takes.G: The dungeon glyph is the mark. Pixel @, no wordmark.
takes.H: Turn left / turn right. Two chevrons only — not a four-way pad.
